entries.zh: 侧栏底部：只剩分隔线 + 版本号（TASK-060 M-01/M-02 / E4·E5 —— 侧栏不提供任何账户入口）
entries.en: Sidebar bottom: only a separator + the version number remain (TASK-060 M-01/M-02 / E4·E5 — the sidebar provides no account entry)

entries.zh: 顶栏头像下拉（TASK-060 M-03 / A-15 / D11·D12）
entries.en: Top bar avatar dropdown (TASK-060 M-03 / A-15 / D11·D12)

entries.zh: 面板 = 身份行（只读，非 a/button）+ 分隔线 + 账户设置 + 退出登录，恰两个动作
entries.en: Panel = identity row (read-only, not an a/button) + separator + Account settings + Sign out, exactly two actions

entries.zh: 身份行：用户名 + 角色同一行；角色弱化（muted，不用 chip 强调）
entries.en: Identity row: username + role on the same line; the role is de-emphasized (muted, not highlighted with a chip)

entries.zh: 登录屏（无侧栏/顶栏）与强制改密闸门
entries.en: Login screen (no sidebar / top bar) and forced password change gate

entries.zh: 注：账户页页内 Tab（.ptabs/.ptab）已于 2026-10-27 随「系统设置独立成页」移除，
entries.en: Note: the in-page Tabs of the account page (.ptabs/.ptab) were removed on 2026-10-27 when System settings became a standalone page,

entries.zh: 系统设置改由顶栏下拉进入（D13）。此处不再保留无引用的样式。
entries.en: System settings is now entered from the top bar dropdown (D13). No unreferenced styles are kept here.

entries.zh: 加载骨架（原 auth 原型 A-13，合并后统一在此定义）
entries.en: Loading skeleton (from the original auth prototype A-13, defined here uniformly after the merge)

entries.zh: 系统态色：红=坏 · 绿=好 —— 与行情「红涨绿跌」语义无关，图例须书面区分
entries.en: System-state colors: red = Bad · green = Good — unrelated to the market red-up / green-down semantics; the legend must state the distinction in writing

entries.zh: F2：详情页操作列两个链接同格并排，须留间距（否则粘连成一个）
entries.en: F2: the two links in the action column of the detail page sit side by side in one cell, so spacing is required (otherwise they stick together as one)

entries.zh: ?record= 命中行高亮 + 明细展开行
entries.en: ?record= highlights the matched row + expands the detail row

entries.zh: 「提醒规则」已移出侧栏，入口在顶栏头像下拉（2026-10-27）；侧栏保持 4 项
entries.en: Alert rules has been moved out of the sidebar; the entry point is now the top bar avatar dropdown (2026-10-27); the sidebar keeps 4 items

entries.zh: 账户唯一入口：顶栏右侧头像下拉（M-03 / D11·D12）。侧栏不再提供任何账户入口。
entries.en: The single account entry point: the avatar dropdown at the right of the top bar (M-03 / D11·D12). The sidebar no longer provides any account entry.

entries.zh: 「系统设置」是独立页面（#/account/users），非 /account 的子 Tab；仅 admin 渲染（D13）
entries.en: System settings is a standalone page (#/account/users), not a sub-Tab of /account; rendered for admin only (D13)

entries.zh: PortoMind 全量产品原型 · v2.0（TASK-059 整改后）
entries.en: PortoMind full product prototype · v2.0 (after the TASK-059 rework)

entries.zh: 设计对齐 docs/ui/1.0（Ardot 设计稿）+ design-tokens.js
entries.en: Design aligned with docs/ui/1.0 (Ardot designs) + design-tokens.js

entries.zh: 路由：hash-based（path + query）；全部状态在内存中 mock，可走通全流程
entries.en: Routing: hash-based (path + query); all state is mocked in memory and the full flow can be walked through
⚠️ Do not copy this verbatim into the implementation

entries.zh: - 本文件的「演示注记」「原型演示数据」等文案只是走查提示，不进产品。
entries.en: - Copy in this file such as demo notes and prototype demo data is only a review hint and must not ship in the product.

entries.zh: - 目标配置弹窗、CSV 导入预览等交互为行为演示；落地形态见 FS（NG-9 跳 /portfolios/edit/:id）。
entries.en: - Interactions such as the target configuration dialog and the CSV import preview are behavior demos; see FS for the shipped form (NG-9 jumps to /portfolios/edit/:id).

entries.zh: - 视觉标尺以 Ardot 9 屏为准；行为标尺以本原型 + FS 为准，冲突时以需求为准。
entries.en: - Ardot's 9 screens are the visual reference; this prototype + FS are the behavioral reference; when they conflict, the requirements win.

entries.zh: - 所有带 data-demo 标记的节点（演示注记 / 预填账号 / 明文口令 mock）落地一律不得照搬 ——
entries.en: - Every node tagged data-demo (demo notes / prefilled accounts / plaintext password mock) must never be copied as-is into the product —

entries.zh: FS §4.1 明文要求「登录页不提示默认账号」。落地检查方式：按 data-demo 全量剔除（不是条件渲染），
entries.en: FS §4.1 explicitly requires that the login page must not hint at default accounts. How to verify: strip everything tagged data-demo (not conditional rendering),
and 0 occurrences should remain after stripping.

entries.zh: - S.session 默认带一个演示登录态（见下方注释），落地实现时不得保留。
entries.en: - S.session carries a demo signed-in state by default (see the comment below); it must not be kept in the implementation.

entries.zh: 认证模块（登录 / 账户 / 系统设置）已于本次合并统一到本文件，
entries.en: The auth module (login / account / system settings) was consolidated into this file in this merge,
and docs/ui/2.0/portomind-auth-prototype.html is reduced to a redirect shell.

notes: L6 <title> 的中文已登记为片段「PortoMind · 产品原型 v2.0」以满足覆盖率检查；_apply-i18n.cjs 对该 title 有硬编码先行替换，故此条在整体替换阶段会显示为「未命中」，属预期。
纯代码/标识符一律未动：CCY_NAME / MARKET_NAME / ACTION_LABEL / REBAL_STATUS 的 key、市场码（CN-SH、CN-SZ、CN-FUND、US、CA、HK）、币种码、TASK/FS/AC 编号、路由路径、data-demo 标记、CSS 类名均保持原样，只翻译字符串值。
跨多行注释按物理行切成多条（如 L84-85、L120-121、L217-218、L455-457、L460-461），英文拼接后仍为通顺整句（每条结尾保留了原文的逗号/句号/破折号位置语义）。
枚举值 SUCCEEDED / PARTIAL / FAILED / SKIPPED 保持原样；仅 Run state 的中文义项在其注释里意译。
演示标的名字翻译为国际通用英文名/拼音（如 沪深300ETF → CSI 300 ETF、天弘余额宝货币 → Tianhong Yu'ebao Money Market Fund），代码符号 510300、0700.HK、XIC 等保持原样。
「组合」相关词一律用 Portfolio（未使用 Asset）；Asset 仅出现在 CSS 类名 .asset-cell 等未改名的标识符里。
